body.statement: There are fixed constants \(C_0,C_1<\infty\) such that \(\inf_{P\in\mathcal M}P_{\mathrm{obs}}^{\otimes n}(\mathcal E_{n,\alpha})\ge1-\alpha\). On \(\mathcal E_{n,\alpha}\), the Jackson spline approximants to every \(f_x,q_x\) and Carathéodory atomic approximants to \(\phi_1,\phi_2\) belong to \(\Theta_{n,\alpha}\), and their ADRF differs from \(\mu\) by at most \(b_{\mu,n}\) on \(I\). For every realized sample satisfying \(\min_xn_x\ge np_{\min}/2\) and \(\Theta_{n,\alpha}\ne\varnothing\), every \(\theta,\theta^{\prime}\in\Theta_{n,\alpha}\) satisfies \(\|\mu_{\theta}-\mu_{\theta^{\prime}}\|_{L^{\infty}(I)}\le C_0\{K_n^{1/2-\beta}+(\lambda_n/n)^{1/2}\}\le C_1r_n\), whether or not \(\mathcal E_{n,\alpha}\) occurs. For every sample, the clipping rule gives \(0\le W_n\le2B_Y\).
body.justification: The concentration-event and clipping components are proved, while constrained feasible embedding and the quantitative bilinear inverse modulus remain the exact upper-side kernel.
body.gap: Qualitative analytic continuation does not provide the required uniform singular-value control or preserve the nonlinear spline constraints.
body.consumer: Once completed, this lemma converts the explicit finite-dimensional confidence set into simultaneous coverage and deterministic width control.

obligation.what_is_open: The constrained-sieve embedding and the quantitative discrete analytic-cocycle modulus at order \(K_n^{1/2-\beta}\) remain unproved.
obligation.obstruction: Local qualitative identifiability supplies no uniform singular-value estimate. The frozen construction supplies neither a proved stability inequality for the bilinear grid map with two unknown atomic error factors nor a shape-preserving Jackson operator that simultaneously preserves normalization, the lower bound on \(I\), both Sobolev-radius constraints, and \(|q|\le B_Yf\).
obligation.attempted: The simultaneous empirical-transform event and global clipping bound were proved. Direct interpolation was then tested, but it neither controls the unknown error factors in the discrete bilinear cocycle nor preserves the nonlinear density and marked-sieve constraints.
obligation.partial_result:
The simultaneous confidence event and clipping assertions are proved. Conditional on the cell labels, each probability-channel summand has modulus at most one and each marked-channel summand has modulus at most \(B_Y\). Applying the real bounded-variable exponential inequality to real and imaginary parts gives, when \(n_x>\lambda_n\),
\[
 P\left(\left.|\widehat F_{x,n}(s,t)-F_x(s,t)|
 >2\sqrt{\lambda_n/n_x}\,\right|\,(X_i)_{i=1}^n\right)
 \le4e^{-\lambda_n},
\]
and the analogous inequality for \(\widehat G_{x,n}\) with radius \(2B_Y\sqrt{\lambda_n/n_x}\). When \(n_x\le\lambda_n\), the deterministic bounds \(|\widehat F_{x,n}-F_x|\le2\) and \(|\widehat G_{x,n}-G_x|\le2B_Y\) apply. A union bound over the two channels, all \(x\in\mathcal X\), and all \((s,t)\in\mathcal D_n\) costs at most
\[
 8|\mathcal X||\mathcal D_n|e^{-\lambda_n}=\alpha/6.
\]
Together with \(\mathrm{lem{:}mass\text{-}confidence}\), this proves the claimed weaker bound \(\inf_{P\in\mathcal M}P_{\mathrm{obs}}^{\otimes n}(\mathcal E_{n,\alpha})\ge1-\alpha\). Also, every feasible \(\mu_\theta\) lies in \([-B_Y,B_Y]\), and the endpoint rule therefore gives \(0\le W_n\le2B_Y\), including the empty-set convention. What remains unproved is the constrained-sieve embedding and the deterministic inverse estimate
\[
 \sup_{\theta,\theta'\in\Theta_{n,\alpha}}
 \|\mu_\theta-\mu_{\theta'}\|_{L^\infty(I)}
 \lesssim K_n^{1/2-\beta}+\sqrt{\lambda_n/n}.
\]
